players.product: PMD ICs - FiberEdge TIA/drivers & CopperEdge linear ACC + photonics (gain chips, high-power CW lasers, SOAs, photodiode arrays)

quarterly_data.signal: Semtech's 10-K: it had no wafer fabrication facilities during fiscal 2026, but following the HieFo Acquisition it now operates foundries that produce certain semiconductor devices used across data center interconnects and intra-data center interconnects; while it continues to outsource a substantial portion of its wafer manufacturing requirements, it now uses a combination of internal manufacturing capabilities and third-party foundries as part of its 'fab-lite' business model. Open capital purchase commitments were $6.1 million as of January 25, 2026.
